title: Warming Midnight Craving Dutch Stew
description: A briny, snappy, midnight-craving Dutch dish featuring cooking wine and robata-grill. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat. Slice the smoked bacon into small pieces and set aside.
Cook the sliced onions in a large kazán cauldron over medium heat until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the cauldron and cook for 4-5 minutes, until they start to release their juices.
Add the sliced carrots to the cauldron and cook for another 4 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the sliced red potatoes to the cauldron and stir to combine.
Add the beef broth, red wine cooking wine, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper to the cauldron. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Add the sliced smoked bacon to the stew and stir to combine.
Simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the bacon is crispy and the stew is heated through.
